title: Calendar/FileNode /copy accept fromAccountId == accountId (RFC 8620 §5.4)
description: Found in the ibyi doc sweep: calendar_event_copy (crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/event.rs) and the FileNode /copy do not reject fromAccountId equal to accountId; RFC 8620 §5.4 says they MUST be different, and Email/copy rejects it with invalidArguments. Check every /copy handler (tasks, contacts, filenode, calendars, object-history) against mail-server and align; add tests.
